slides.title: Good deals stall when nobody [owns the risk].
slides.lede: A strong commercial case can still lose to indecision, delay or a familiar incumbent. Committees manage collective risk.

slides.quote: What happens to me if this decision fails?
slides.text: Operations fears disruption. Finance fears unproven benefits. IT fears security exposure. Each stakeholder carries a different risk.

slides.title: Committees buy [defensibility], not just value
slides.text: If a committee cannot confidently explain a distinctive approach internally, the conventional option with clear milestones may win, even when the committee believes the other has more potential.

slides.title: Enthusiasm is not [influence]
slides.note: If none of these happens, treat them as **an interested contact**, not a risk-bearing advocate.
